title: David Makes a Big Mistake
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler with the brave heart, and tonight King David keeps looking at what is not his until one wrong choice leads to another: Beau turns his whole body away from a toy that isn’t his and tells his dad.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because it takes a brave heart to look away. In Beau’s world today: at the store, Beau sees a shiny toy car sitting in someone else’s cart while its owner is looking at cereal. Beau really, really wants it, and his hand starts to reach. Then Beau turns his whole body around, walks back to his dad, and says, “I wanted to take something that isn’t mine.” His dad hugs him and says, “That was brave.” Unlike King David, who kept on looking, Beau learned that the best time to stop a wrong choice is right at the start.
